name: Daniel dos Santos
biography: Daniel dos Santos is the Head of Security Research at Forescout's Vedere Labs, where he leads a team of researchers that identifies new vulnerabilities and monitors active threats. He holds a PhD in computer science, has published over 35 peer-reviewed papers on cybersecurity, has found or disclosed hundreds of CVEs and is a frequent speaker at security conferences.
